primary_sources.constraint: Profile load completes before return under LOGON_WITH_PROFILE, but process initialization may still fail. Requires local-logon permission and non-LocalSystem caller. Mutable command line <=1024 characters, explicit full application path, target-user image/CWD/desktop access and valid standard handles remain gates. Current-host unload timing cannot be inferred from XP/Server2003 notes.

Assignment needs job assignment and process quota/terminate rights. Existing-job nesting and UI-limit compatibility, same session and inherited limits must be qualified before resume; assignment may fail and cannot count as ownership success.
Nested job process lists include child jobs. Empty completion requires a successful complete observation with both assigned and listed counts zero while the job handle remains owned.

Explicit loading needs suitable token rights, backup/restore privileges and administrator/LocalSystem caller. hProfile is closed by UnloadUserProfile, not CloseHandle; registry handles must retire first.
This unload API applies to an explicit LoadUserProfile hProfile. All opened hive keys must close. Implicit LOGON_WITH_PROFILE supplies no such returned hProfile.
Profile deletion requires administrative privileges and the exact SID; local computer parameter must be NULL on current Windows. It is separate from account deletion.
Fresh local creation uses NULL server name, checks exact native NERR_Success, and uses a name <=20 characters. Existing-user result does not transfer ownership.

required_future_admissions: exact new Map build and complete DLL/data closure
target-user image/CWD/desktop ACLs and valid private log capture
compatible same-session owned job and verified returned process/primary-thread handles before resume
complete job/direct-process exit before bounded current-host hive-unloaded observation
actual current Map/Db endpoint and registered/not-starting readiness observation
scope_precision: The 59 named functions cover 66 pinned definitions because seven utility functions also have alternate platform stubs; Windows selects definition index0.
Original regGetInstallationDir retains an HKEY on NULL-return branches; teardown must prove process/job retirement, not only root termination.
CreateProcessWithLogonW success/profile loaded is not successful DLL initialization or Map readiness.
Old direct imports omit dynamically preloaded PhysXCore and never prove its transitive runtime closure.
A client ready-send is not a Db-received transition; the future observer must bind actual current channel and container.
